$comment: Expectations for scripts/offline-feature-probe.mjs. Slugs are the settings panel ids (data-settings-panel-slug), stable across Store versions. mode: the probe launches with an API-key auth.json and no ChatGPT login, network blocked. expectVisible/expectHidden were confirmed in the UI; notes give the label and reason for sections hidden in this mode, taken from the renderer's own visibility rules (use-visible-settings-sections, 26.1007). Reasons are user-facing: keep gate ids and internals out of them (record those in CHANGELOG/docs instead).
